actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 380 - 33 (Roll no. 196). (text: 7/14/2025 CR 3218-3219)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 380 - 33 (Roll no. 196).

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 1717.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3218-3220)
Mr. Latta moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill.
Placed on the Union Calendar, Calendar No. 158.
Reported by the Committee on Energy and Commerce. H. Rept. 119-194.
Reported by the Committee on Energy and Commerce. H. Rept. 119-194.
Ordered to be Reported by the Yeas and Nays: 50 - 1.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Energy and Commerce.

dimensions.assessment: Affects communications industry representatives, academic institutions, public interest groups, and government members appointed to the council.
dimensions.evidence: Representatives of companies in the communications industry... public interest organizations or academic institutions

dimensions.assessment: Provides an advisory and reporting function on communications network security and reliability.
dimensions.evidence: advise the Commission on issues including the security, reliability, and interoperability of communications networks

dimensions.assessment: No specific funding amounts or appropriations are mentioned in the text.
Establishes a statutory advisory council and exempts it from standard federal advisory committee termination requirements.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1013(a)(2) of title 5, United States Code (relating to the termination of advisory committees) shall not apply to the council.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent exemption from termination for the advisory council, with members serving two-year terms.
dimensions.evidence: each member of the council shall be appointed for a term of 2 years

missing_information: Specific cost of operating the advisory council
importance_detail.rationale: Gives statutory authority to an FCC advisory council on communications network security and exempts it from standard advisory committee termination rules.
